sentences: The Echo terminal sends a SessionRequest message carrying a random session value and waits for a SessionAccept message.
While waiting, it does not send any other message on CCH1.
Waiting lasts at most the duration of timer T901.

requirements.text: The terminal shall send a SessionRequest message carrying a random session value.
The terminal shall wait for a SessionAccept message after sending the SessionRequest message.
While waiting for a SessionAccept message, the terminal shall not send any other message on CCH1.
The terminal shall wait for a SessionAccept message for at most the duration of timer T901.
